WASHINGTON — A defiant Secretary of War Pete Hegseth fired back at plans to impeach him, declaring that he won’t back down.

The House is expected to vote on an impeachment resolution Hegseth that outgoing libertarian-leaning Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Ky.) introduced in September when it gavels back into session next week.

Follow for live updates on the 2026 Midterm Elections

“Just like the president. We don’t back down. And that especially applies now,” Hegseth declared in a nearly six-minute video message filmed outside the Department of War.

At the War Department: We Stand.We Fight. We Defend the Republic. pic.twitter.com/Kkr0DazmCE

“This is not about me, but of course, the other side, in case you’ve noticed, they’re obsessed,” Hegseth went on. “A disgruntled, defeated congressman, along with all his Democrat allies, has also dropped sham articles of impeachment against yours truly, just like they tried against President Trump twice.”

Hegseth had campaigned against Massie in his primary — a highly unusual move for a Pentagon honcho. Massie justified his impeachment push against Hegseth by citing Hegseth’s role in the war in Iran.

Many Democrats have signaled plans to potentially impeach Hegseth when they roar back to power next year with one of the largest House majorities since at least 2008.

Rumors have swirled that Hegseth could step down and get an appointment by Tennessee Gov.-elect Marsha Blackburn to fill her soon-to-be vacant old Senate seat. Hegseth’s close allies have shot those rumors down.

The secretary of war also used his video message to push for lawmakers to pass additional funding for the Department of War.

پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود بیشتر مشاهده کنید. واشنگتن - پیت هگزت، وزیر جنگ سرکش، به طرح های استیضاح او پاسخ داد و اعلام کرد که از موضع خود عقب نشینی نمی کند. انتظار می رود مجلس به قطعنامه استیضاح هگست رای دهد که توماس ماسی، نماینده برکنار گرایش به آزادیخواهان رای می دهد. در مورد انتخابات میان دوره ای 2026
درست مثل رئیس جمهور. ما عقب نشینی نمی کنیم هگزت در یک پیام ویدئویی نزدیک به شش دقیقه‌ای که خارج از وزارت جنگ فیلم‌برداری شده است، اعلام کرد: ما ایستاده‌ایم. ما می‌جنگیم. ما از جمهوری دفاع می‌کنیم. pic.twitter.com/Kkr0DazmCE
هگزت ادامه داد: "این مربوط به من نیست، اما البته، طرف مقابل، اگر متوجه شده باشید، آنها وسواس دارند." یک نماینده ناراضی و شکست خورده کنگره، همراه با همه متحدان دموکرات خود، مقالات ساختگی استیضاح شما را نیز واقعاً کنار گذاشته است، درست همانطور که دو بار علیه رئیس جمهور ترامپ تلاش کردند.»
هگست در انتخابات مقدماتی خود علیه ماسی مبارزات انتخاباتی انجام داده بود - حرکتی بسیار غیرعادی برای یکی از صداداران پنتاگون. ماسی فشار استیضاح خود علیه هگزث را با استناد به نقش هگزث در جنگ ایران توجیه کرد. بسیاری از دموکرات‌ها زمانی که سال آینده با یکی از بزرگترین اکثریت‌های مجلس نمایندگان از سال 2008 به قدرت برسند، برنامه‌هایی را برای استیضاح احتمالی هگزت اعلام کرده‌اند. شایعات حاکی از آن است که هگزت می‌تواند از سمت خود کناره‌گیری کند و مارشا بلک‌برن، فرماندار منتخب تنسی، به زودی او را به قدرت برساند.

news.originalContent:

This was supposed to be a wasted season for Steph Curry.

The Warriors were injury-riddled and coming off a lackluster summer in which they made no major moves.

It meant the greatest shooter of all time was destined to tread water as he turned 39 years old.

Yaxel Lendeborg changed everything.

He has resuscitated Curry’s career. He has breathed new life into a flailing dynasty. He has given the Warriors their future franchise star.

Lendeborg was a question mark when the Warriors selected him as the No. 11 pick in the 2026 draft.

Can a jack-of-all-trades turn into a star? Can a 24-year-old surpass expectations or has he already peaked? Can a rookie really be NBA ready?

Lendeborg has emphatically answered those questions.

He’s averaging 21.5 points (50% shooting from the field, 40% from 3), seven rebounds and 3.9 assists for the Warriors, who have won five games in a row.

The Warriors are good. Curry has a wingman. This is thrilling for anyone who loves basketball.

No one seems to be savoring this more than Curry, whose joy has been on full display amid the Warriors’ unexpected rise.

During his 44-point deluge against the Timberwolves on Oct. 28, Curry flashed a lunge pose after sinking a shot from beyond the arc.

After his jab sent Luka Doncic onto his butt and he swished a 3-pointer against the Lakers on Oct. 30, he did the Edvard Munch celebration, putting his hands on his cheeks and opening his mouth in shock.

And after scoring 34 points against the Suns on Monday, he didn’t hesitate when asked what has changed for the Warriors this season.

“I mean, Yax,” Curry said, flashing a smile.

Curry and Lendeborg are the NBA’s second-highest scoring duo (51.5 points per game), behind Luka Dončić and Austin Reaves (61.8). Lendeborg’s success has been a life raft for the Warriors, who are without Jimmy Butler and Moses Moody for the first few months of the season and without Kristaps Porzingis indefinitely.

In many ways, Lendeborg has unlocked Curry. He has made his brilliance count. He has lit a new fire under him.

Curry, who missed 27 straight games because of runner’s knee last season, is averaging 30 points (46.8% shooting from the field, 42.9% from beyond the arc), 4.2 rebounds and 4.5 assists per game.

He just surpassed Michael Jordan (44) for the most 40-point games in NBA history since turning 30, notching his 45th such performance last week.

Curry is playing as though he were a decade younger. And that’s because a guy 14 years younger than him is making all of this meaningful.

It’s funny because this really couldn’t have worked out better for both parties.

Curry, a two-time MVP and four-time champion, is doing what he loves most: winning.

And the outspoken Lendeborg has found a team that needs him to contribute immediately and encourages his bravado, two things that could’ve been problematic with other franchises.

Patience isn’t Lendeborg’s strong suit.

And neither is being politically correct.

The rookie recently raised eyebrows when he stunningly said he lost all respect for Dončić following their trash talk in the season opener. The Warriors didn’t wince.

Instead, Curry, Draymond Green and coach Steve Kerr unapologetically had his back.

Lendeborg landed in the perfect situation. He has a mentor in Green, who’s famous for unabashedly speaking his mind. And he has a franchise behind him with a win-now mentality that needs him to shine.

Lendeborg has found his home. He can flourish here. He needs to flourish here.

He has found his life preserver.

It’s in the form of a rookie who has made it so that instead of treading water he’s soaring.
news.content: پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. قرار بود این فصل برای استف کوری تلف شده باشد. جنگجویان آسیب دیده بودند و در تابستانی ضعیف بودند که در آن هیچ حرکت مهمی انجام ندادند. این بدان معنا بود که بزرگترین تیرانداز تمام دوران در 39 سالگی قرار بود آب را زیر پا بگذارد. یاکسل لندبرگسوس همه چیز را تغییر داده است. او جان تازه‌ای به سلسله‌ای در حال فروپاشی دمیده است. او ستاره فرنچایز آینده خود را به Warriors داده است. زمانی که Warriors او را به عنوان گزینه شماره 11 در درافت 2026 انتخاب کردند، لندبورگ یک علامت سوال بود. آیا یک جوان 24 ساله می تواند از انتظارات فراتر رود یا قبلاً به اوج رسیده است؟ آیا یک تازه‌کار واقعاً می‌تواند برای NBA آماده باشد؟ لندبورگ با قاطعیت به این سؤالات پاسخ داده است. او میانگین 21.5 امتیاز (50٪ شوت از زمین، 40٪ از 3)، هفت ریباند و 3 کسب کرده است. 9 پاس گل برای واریرز که پنج بازی متوالی را برده اند. واریرز خوب هستند. کاری یک وینگمن دارد. این برای هر کسی که بسکتبال را دوست دارد هیجان‌انگیز است. به نظر می‌رسد هیچ‌کس بیشتر از کری که شادی‌اش در میان صعود غیرمنتظره واریرز کاملاً به نمایش درآمده است. در طول سیل 44 امتیازی خود در برابر تیمبرولوز در 28 اکتبر، کوری پس از شلیک یک شوت از آنسوی قوس، ژست لانژ گرفت. پس از ضربه زدن او، لوکا دونچیچ را روی باسنش فرستاد و او در 30 اکتبر یک پرتاب 3 امتیازی مقابل لیکرز زد، جشن ادوارد مونک را انجام داد، دست‌هایش را روی گونه‌هایش گذاشت و دهانش را با شوک باز کرد.

Thanksgiving is right around the corner, and it might be time to consider giving your gut a little reboot before the real feasting begins. Some shoppers seem to have stumbled upon a solution — but not without a few side effects.

The product in question is Seed’s 14-Day Reset, which retails for $25 on Amazon and features 24 clinically and scientifically studied probiotic strains in a plant-based prebiotic outer capsule. According to the brand, the capsules are designed to support healthy gut function by reinforcing the gut barrier.

However, the supplement comes with a warning. Some users may experience “temporary gastrointestinal changes” as their body adjusts to the formula. Generally, the effects ease over time.

“After years of gut instability and near-liquid passing, I decided to give this a try,” one shopper shared. “Yes, it caused intense pressure and cramping in the left lower abdomen. It does note this on the packaging as well. But it changed my life!”

They went on to explain that the cramping eventually stopped, and they’ve now been “solid and regular” for about three months.

“I can go out to eat without stopping mid-meal to use the restroom. This might not be for the faint of heart but it absolutely worked,” they concluded.

Beyond regularity, other reviewers have noted that it has helped reduce bloating, while some even claim to have lost a few pounds since using it.

“Could be a coincidence but after a few days of taking this I lost 1-2 lbs and I’ve been tracking my weight all the time, so its surprising it hasn’t gone back up (water weight). My digestion seems better and overall I think my gut bacteria is getting better,” another user shared.

The brand suggests starting with two capsules daily for two weeks. If symptoms become severe, you can reduce the dosage to one capsule per day.

DS-01 Gut Reset is third-party tested for quality and safety. As with any supplement, be sure to consult a physiciain prioir to use — especially if you have any preexisting health conditions.

Ready to upgrade your wellness regimen? Vital Proteins collagen peptides are formulated to aid in supporting hair, skin, and nail health with collagen peptides made from grass-fed, pasture-raised bovine hides.

If you’re ready to crank up your NAD+ levels, the TRU NIAGEN PRO NAD+ is a great place to start. This formula is shown to increase NAD+ levels in three weeks and has decades of research behind it.

Formulated with 60 billion CFU and 10 diverse probiotic strains, Physician’s Choice Probiotics are designed to restore healthy gut flora, support digestion, and strengthen immune function.

This article was written by Miska Salemann, New York Post Commerce Writer/Reporter. As a health-forward member of Gen Z, Miska seeks out experts to weigh in on the benefits, safety and designs of both trending and tried-and-true fitness equipment, workout clothing, dietary supplements and more. Taking matters into her own hands, Miska intrepidly tests wellness products, ranging from Bryan Johnson’s Blueprint Longevity Mix to the viral Oura Ring to Jennifer Aniston’s favorite workout platform – often with her adorable toddler by her side. Before joining The Post, Miska covered lifestyle and consumer topics for the U.S. Sun and The Cannon Beach Gazette.

Richard Barrera, the San Diego school board president backed by California’s powerful teachers union, has won the race for state superintendent of public instruction.

“Last night, voters made their choice,” Chino Valley school board president Sonja Shaw said Thursday as she conceded. “I would be lying if I said my heart wasn’t heavy. As a mother and a protector of children, I feel deeply saddened for the kids. They are the ones who deserve so much better,” she added.

Barrera led with 4,014,765 votes, about 57.6%, to Shaw’s 2,959,230, about 42.4%, a margin of more than 1 million votes, according to results updated Thursday morning. All precincts had reported their ballots.

“More than $10 million was poured into this race against us and we were up against a political machine that has been in place for decades. We didn’t have that kind of money or machinery,” Shaw said. “What we had were people. Mamas, dads, papas, Grammy bears, teachers, parents and everyday Californians who linked arms because they believe our children are worth fighting for.”

Barrera, 59, who has yet to make a public statement, steps into a now largely moot role that looks very different from the one outgoing Superintendent Tony Thurmond held.

Under a law Gov. Gavin Newsom signed this summer, the next governor will appoint an education commissioner to run the California Department of Education beginning in 2027 — removing the department oversight that has long defined the elected post.

The superintendent will instead become a voting member of the State Board of Education and join the California Community Colleges Board of Governors, while remaining a UC regent and CSU trustee.

The new superintendent and the commissioner are expected to spend the first six months of 2027 negotiating a job description to bring back to the Legislature.

Governor-elect Xavier Becerra will appoint the state’s first commissioner of education.

Neither candidate supported the overhaul.

Shaw called it an unconstitutional “power grab” and said she plans to sue to stop future governors from appointing a commissioner, though legal experts have said such a suit is unlikely to succeed.

Barrera was more accepting of the change and has pitched using the office to draft an education budget with local educators and parents before the governor releases his spending plan each January.

Shaw, 44, thanked her husband and two daughters but noted her work isn’t finished.

“I don’t know exactly what God has next, but I know He isn’t finished,” she said. “California’s kids still deserve an education that prepares them for life. Parents still deserve to be heard. Teachers deserve support. And our children deserve adults willing to stand up for them.”

“The election may be over, but the work and the mission don’t end here,” she added.

Shaw and Barrera advanced from a 10-candidate June primary that included several legislative veterans, among them Assemblyman Al Muratsuchi and former Assembly Speaker Anthony Rendon. Rendon later conceded and endorsed Barrera.

Shaw finished first with 22.6% of the vote, or roughly 1.74 million ballots. Barrera took 20.3%, about 1.56 million.

Shaw, who was elected to the Chino Valley Unified board in 2022 and was a stay-at-home mother before the pandemic, made headlines in 2023 when she presided over a board meeting at which Thurmond was escorted out during a heated debate over a policy requiring schools to notify parents if their child identifies as transgender.

California has since barred districts from enforcing such policies, a law Shaw wants to undo.

She also opposes allowing transgender girls to compete in girls’ sports and backs reinstating the SAT requirement for UC admissions.

She was endorsed by the California Republican Party, Moms for Liberty California and the California Rifle and Pistol Association.

Barrera, a longtime labor organizer, has served on the San Diego Unified board for 18 years and works as a senior adviser for special projects at the state Department of Education.

He supports Prop. 3, which would make permanent the high-earner income tax that funds schools, and has called for more counselors, nurses and smaller class sizes. He opposes bringing back the SAT requirement and supports the state’s LGBTQ+ student protections.

Barrera won the backing of the California Democratic Party and, unusually, both the California Teachers Association and its longtime rival, the California Charter Schools Association.

The CTA spent $8.4 million supporting Barrera and opposing Shaw, according to campaign finance records.

During an October debate hosted by EdSource, Barrera repeatedly tied Shaw to President Donald Trump, while Shaw accused him of “Trump derangement syndrome.”

Barrera has said Shaw used her platform to divide people and bully vulnerable students; Shaw has argued Barrera treats student outcomes as a talking point.

The Post has reached out to Barrera for comment.

A beloved San Francisco staple that has spent nearly three decades feeding downtown office workers has been forced out of its long-running location after its corporate landlord pulled the rug out from the under the owners.

Oasis Grill, a family-owned Mediterranean eatery that has dished out gyros, shawarma wraps and kebabs since 1999, served its final meal at its 1st Street location last week, after their lease was handed to another restaurant, according to the San Francisco Standard.

“We were blindsided,” co-owner Muna Azzghayer told the outlet.

The biggest news, opinion and culture shaping California right now.

Please provide a valid email.

By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

While Oasis Grill survived the economic ups and downs of the city’s business district, it couldn’t survive its landlord.

Azzghayer and her husband, Mohammad Zughaiyir, told the Standard they were caught off guard when commercial real estate giant Kilroy Reality declined to renew their lease, which expired at the end of October. Instead, the landlord informed the couple that another restaurant would be taking over their longtime home.

The trouble began brewing earlier this year when building management started parading prospective tenants through the bustling storefront, according to Azzghayer.

When she pressed for answers about whether their lease was in jeopardy, management was reportedly silent.

Azzghayer believes the business fell victim to a ruthless bidding war, suspecting that the incoming tenant simply offered dollar figures the mom and mom eatery couldn’t match.

“They’re looking for more rent than what we’re paying, and they brought somebody else in and told us, basically, bye,” Azzghayer told the Standard. “We were committed to San Francisco, we believed in San Francisco, and I guess we paid the price for it.”

The eviction carries an especially brutal financial sting.

Back in 2015, the owners sank roughly $2 million and an entire year transforming the counter-service space from the ground up, including installing brand new commercial gas lines.

Shortly after completing the extensive overhaul, the business was pummeled by the COVID-19 pandemic, weathering years of cratered foot traffic and remote work policies that left the Financial District resembling a ghost town.

While the 1st Street location is gone, Oasis Grill still serves customers at three remaining San Francisco outposts on Drumm Street, 4th Street and Market Street.

Oasis Grill، یک غذاخوری مدیترانه ای متعلق به خانواده که از سال 1999 ژیرو، کاسه شاورما و کباب میل کرده است، طبق استاندارد سانفرانسیسکو، آخرین وعده غذایی خود را هفته گذشته پس از اینکه اجاره آنها به رستوران دیگری واگذار شد، در محل خیابان اول خود سرو کرد. اکنون.لطفا یک ایمیل معتبر ارائه دهید. با کلیک کردن بر روی بالا، با شرایط استفاده و خط‌مشی رازداری موافقت می‌کنید. در حالی که Oasis Grill از فراز و نشیب‌های اقتصادی منطقه تجاری شهر جان سالم به در برد، نتوانست از صاحبخانه خود دوام بیاورد. Azzghayer و همسرش، محمد Zughaiyir، به استاندارد گفتند که وقتی غول املاک تجاری تجاری Kilroy Reality در اکتبر به پایان رسید، غافلگیر شدند. در عوض، صاحبخانه به زن و شوهر اطلاع داد که رستوران دیگری خانه قدیمی آنها را تصاحب خواهد کرد. به گفته ازغایر، زمانی که مدیریت ساختمان شروع به رژه رفتن مستاجران احتمالی از طریق ویترین فروشگاهی شلوغ کرد، مشکل شروع شد. به گفته ازغایر، وقتی او برای پاسخ به این سوال که آیا اجاره آنها در خطر است یا نه، مدیریت سکوت کرده است.

The mayor-elect then turned to the incumbent, tracing her career from the emergency room to City Hall.

“I also wanted to pay tribute to Mayor Karen Bass, someone who has given decades of her life to making this city what it is today,” Raman said.

She cited Bass’s time as an emergency-room nurse, her founding of Community Coalition, her leadership in Sacramento and Washington, and her election as the city’s first woman mayor.

“I know so many people, not just across this city but across this country, are grateful for her dedication to the promise of Los Angeles,” she said.

She saved her most direct appeal for voters who backed Bass, or sat the election out.

“I am going to City Hall to work every single day to earn your trust and to earn your trust in this city again,” Raman said.

She said that the work for her “starts now” to get housing people can afford, parks for children, a transit system that can “get people where they need to go,” and a city government “that is actually capable of delivering on its promises.”

“I love this city and I love its people, and I cannot wait to get started on building a better future together with all of you,” she said. “Thank you so much, Los Angeles.”

Earlier today, Bass conceded defeat and called Raman to congratulate her on her victory. She also pledged a smooth transition, saying Los Angeles voters had spoken despite the disappointing outcome.

“I love Los Angeles. I believe in Los Angeles. And I will continue to ensure the promise of a better life belongs to all of us. Thank you,” Bass said in her final message.

Los Angeles cops say the election of Nithya Raman could obliterate the city’s already struggling police force and harm public safety.

Raman, the socialist City councilwoman, won the mayoral election on Thursday, unseating Karen Bass.

The 45-year-old pledged to replace Los Angeles Police Chief Jim McDonnell for not doing enough to stop ICE from nabbing illegal migrants in the city.

She’s also come under fire for suggesting McDonnell and the LAPD are ”fascist liars” in a shocking video with an influencer that was posted to social media video.

During her initial 2020 campaign for council, she called for the police to be defunded.

There is no more urgent or possible moment to end the racial, environmental, and moral crisis that is homelessness in LA. Our leaders have finally been forced to listen. The path is not complicated: fund services. Fund housing. Fund care.Defund the police.

Raman will face pressure from her lefty Democratic Socialists of America backers to gut the LAPD and neuter its policies, infuriating officers who claim this would lead to chaos on the streets.

“It’s going to be a nightmare and very, very bad for public safety,” one senior officer said of Raman’s win.

Cops and LAPD brass claim the department is “woefully understaffed,” with just 8,500 officers to cover Los Angeles’ population of 3.8 million.

Crime in Los Angeles is down in every category, with and officer-involved shootings having dropped by 53% this year.

One LAPD officer rejected Raman’s argument that falling crime means the city needs fewer cops.

“We can barely keep things under control as-is,” said the officer. “If she cuts the budget we’ll have nothing left.”

Raman has vowed to oust McDonnell if elected, despite his term running through 2030, and with important events like the 2028 Olympics.

Raman claims the LAPD has secretly shared sensitive information with Immigration and Customs Enforcement, potentially putting undocumented immigrants at risk.

“There have been reports, credible reports, that LAPD has actually shared information with ICE, including information from our fingerprint databases and through Flock cameras,” Raman claimed.

But McDonnell has flatly rejected the accusations, insisting the department is prohibited by California law from assisting federal immigration enforcement.

“I was out there,” McDonnell told The Post in a pointed reference to Raman’s happy hour drinks session as the city burned during last year’s violent anti-ICE protests.

“I don’t know that people who are criticizing us were anywhere near there.”

Jamie McBride, of the Los Angeles Police Protective League, issued a dire warning as Nithya Raman widened her lead in the LA mayoral race Wednesday.

“If Nithya Raman becomes the mayor, the city needs to prepare for Armageddon,” he told NBC LA.

“She won’t have to defund the police; police officers will just leave the department.”

Mayor Karen Bass warned during the campaign that firing the chief 18 months before the 2028 Olympics would be disastrous.

Two years after playing a major role in helping President Trump secure his 2024 win, Latino men have dramatically swung the other way.

Democrats swept the House and Senate in a Midterm massacre for the GOP Tuesday — and Latino men played a significant role in the historic sweep.

Follow for live updates on the 2026 Midterm Elections

NBC’s exit poll on Tuesday showed Latino men nationwide favored Democrats by 56%, compared to 41% for Republicans.

In 2024, NBC’s exit poll showed Latino men swinging right, favoring Republicans by 54% and Democrats by 44%.

Political commentator Samantha Karlin told The Post that Trump appealed to Latino men in 2024 with promises of “prosperity, strength, and security” — but said many are finding that those promises “haven’t translated into a better quality of life.”

She added that Trump’s immigration crackdown may have also played a role in the dramatic swing.

“There’s a profound difference between supporting border security and watching people who look like you, your family, and your neighbors being targeted by aggressive immigration enforcement,’ she said.

Karlin added that living with the fear that you or someone you love could be detained, regardless of legal status, creates “tremendous insecurity.”

“According to UnidosUS, 83% of Latino voters are struggling financially. The American Dream increasingly feels out of reach,” she continued.

“I think many Latino men are realizing that Trump’s strongman image doesn’t translate into economic security or protection for their communities.”

On Tuesday night, Republicans lost Senate races in traditionally red states Iowa, Maine, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina and Texas, with Democrats also securing the House.

In Texas, James Talarico made history by becoming the first Democrat elected to the US Senate from Texas since 1988, beating state Attorney General Ken Paxton.

Associated Press exit poll showed that 62% of voters blamed Trump’s policies for higher prices, with 71% saying Congress must do more to check the president.

“The Democrats did a good job,” Trump told Fox News. “They fought hard.”

He acknowledged the Iran war is partly to blame for the Republican losses.

“People agree with what I’m doing on Iran, but they really probably weren’t willing to do the short-term consequence of paying more for gasoline. I understand that. I don’t agree with it,” he said.
news.content:
پوشش های بیشتری از ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. دو سال پس از ایفای نقش مهم در کمک به رئیس جمهور ترامپ برای تضمین پیروزی خود در سال 2024، مردان لاتین تبار به طرز چشمگیری به سمت دیگری حرکت کردند. دموکرات ها مجلس و سنا را در یک قتل عام میان دوره ای برای حزب جمهوری خواه سه شنبه شکست دادند - و مردان لاتین نقش مهمی در این انتخابات تاریخی داشتند. نظرسنجی خروج ان‌بی‌سی در روز سه‌شنبه نشان داد که مردان لاتین تبار در سراسر کشور 56 درصد از دموکرات‌ها در مقایسه با 41 درصد برای جمهوری‌خواهان حمایت می‌کنند. در سال 2024، نظرسنجی خروج NBC نشان داد مردان لاتین تبار با 54 درصد از جمهوری‌خواهان و 44 درصد از دموکرات‌ها حمایت می‌کنند. سامانتا کارلین، مفسر سیاسی، به The Post گفت که ترامپ در سال 2024 از مردان لاتین تبار با وعده‌های «بهروزی، قدرت و امنیت» دعوت کرد - اما گفت که بسیاری متوجه شده‌اند که این وعده‌ها «به کیفیت زندگی بهتر ترجمه نشده است».
او افزود که سرکوب مهاجرت ترامپ نیز ممکن است در این نوسانات چشمگیر نقش داشته باشد. او گفت: «تفاوت عمیقی بین حمایت از امنیت مرزی و تماشای افرادی که شبیه شما، خانواده‌تان و همسایگانتان هستند که توسط نیروهای تهاجمی مهاجرت هدف قرار می‌گیرند وجود دارد. کارلین اضافه کرد که زندگی با ترس از اینکه شما یا کسی که دوستش دارید بدون توجه به وضعیت قانونی بازداشت شوند، «ناامنی فوق‌العاده» ایجاد می‌کند.
بر اساس آمار UnidosUS، 83 درصد از رای دهندگان لاتین تبار از نظر مالی دچار مشکل هستند. رویای آمریکایی به طور فزاینده ای دور از دسترس به نظر می رسد

news.originalContent:
The American Empire is in a crisis. The Iran War is an ongoing disaster. The Republican Party is on life support. And the Department of War is rolling out a podcast about Admiral Bradley Cooper’s abiding love for French fries.

In a set reminiscent of “Between Two Ferns” with Zach Galifianakis, Cooper sat down for the DOW’s inaugural episode of “Inside CENTCOM.” The podcast was launched to “introduce the incredible warfighters that make up thousands of troops protecting America forward in the Middle East,” and the studio even featured neon lights. Because what is a podcast without some neon lights? (RELATED: Iranian War Has Reportedly Cost Each American Household $2,000)

Listen to the first full episode of CENTCOM’s new podcast "Inside CENTCOM" — out now on podcast platforms or on YouTube: https://t.co/0uN6TgVuez https://t.co/32jF5GVpIC

After watching the 11-minute episode, I learned that Cooper really loves fries, typically skips lunch, and is a Cincinnati Bengals fan. I also learned that the DOW is kind of a joke.

Why? Why would they think it’s a good idea to start a propaganda podcast the day after voters spanked the Trump administration for dragging the country into yet another fruitless Middle East war? With the Strait of Hormuz contested, global shipping costs about to climb permanently higher, and Americans suffering financially here at home, Cooper and the rest of the DOW already look bad enough as it is. When your house is on fire, you don’t take the time to set up some studio lighting and quickly record an episode. (RELATED: Hidden Cost Of War That Trickles Down To Your Grocery Bill Set To Explode In 2027)

But this is, regrettably, typical of the second Trump administration, where so many things have been turned into cheap spectacles, such as the ballroom or the reflecting pool. From the Epstein binders stunt to the White House social media account turning CENTCOM footage of the Iran War strikes into video game memes, when a government turns itself into a joke, people get angry and nihilistic. Americans who can barely keep up with bills didn’t re-elect Trump in 2024 so that his administration could make sick memes and podcasts.

The DOW’s podcast could not have come at a worse time. Our military can’t win wars anymore, but it can set up a mean podcast studio. To call that absurd would be an understatement.
news.content:
امپراتوری آمریکا در بحران است. جنگ ایران یک فاجعه مداوم است. حزب جمهوری خواه تحت حمایت زندگی است. و وزارت جنگ در حال پخش پادکستی در مورد عشق همیشگی دریاسالار بردلی کوپر به سیب زمینی سرخ کرده است. در مجموعه ای که یادآور «میان دو سرخس» با زک گالیفیاناکیس است، کوپر در قسمت افتتاحیه DOW از «Inside CENTCOM» نشست. این پادکست برای "معرفی جنگجویان باورنکردنی که هزاران سرباز را تشکیل می دهند که از آمریکا در خاورمیانه محافظت می کنند" راه اندازی شد و استودیو حتی چراغ های نئونی را نیز به نمایش گذاشت. زیرا پادکست بدون نورهای نئون چیست؟
اولین قسمت کامل پادکست جدید CENTCOM "Inside CENTCOM" را بشنوید — اکنون در پلتفرم های پادکست یا در YouTube: https://t. co/0uN6TgVuez https://t.co/32jF5GVpIC
پس از تماشای قسمت 11 دقیقه ای، متوجه شدم که کوپر واقعا عاشق سیب زمینی سرخ شده است، معمولا ناهار را حذف می کند و از طرفداران سینسیناتی بنگالز است. من همچنین فهمیدم که DOW نوعی شوخی است. چرا؟ چرا آنها فکر می کنند که ایده خوبی است که یک پادکست تبلیغاتی را از روزی که رای دهندگان دولت ترامپ را به دلیل کشاندن کشور به یک جنگ بی نتیجه دیگر در خاورمیانه مورد ضرب و شتم قرار دادند، راه اندازی کنند؟ با مشاجره تنگه هرمز، هزینه‌های حمل و نقل جهانی برای همیشه بالاتر می‌رود، و آمریکایی‌هایی که از لحاظ مالی در خانه خود رنج می‌برند، کوپر و بقیه DOW در حال حاضر به اندازه کافی بد به نظر می‌رسند. وقتی خانه شما در آتش می‌سوزد، وقت نمی‌گذارید تا شما را آتش بزنید

news.originalContent:
As more of the closest races from Tuesday’s elections are counted, the results show just how strong the blue wave really is.

While it was clear by the next morning that Democrats had taken both the U.S. House and Senate, many races have yet to be called. At the time of publication, the Associated Press had called 247 House seats for Democrats and 153 for Republicans, along with 54 Senate seats for Democrats and 44 for Republicans. (RELATED: Democrats Gains In The South Are An Oddly Specific Fulfillment Of A 60-Year-Old Prophecy)

Some of the latest Democratic pickups are in North Carolina, Virginia, and Arizona, as voters push back against the GOP and its leader, President Donald Trump, according to Politico.

Three of the four seats Democrats won in North Carolina districts affected by Republican-initiated redistricting flipped from red to blue, Politico reported. The victories included those of Democrats Cyril Jefferson, Paul Barringer, and Lakesha Womack.

A woman holds a sign to vote blue near the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool as President Donald Trump delivers remarks on November 2, 2026 in Washington, DC. (Photo by Kevin Carter/Getty Images)

All eight North Carolina districts called by the Associated Press went to Democrats, while Republicans led in only four of the six districts still being counted.

The Democratic lead was further reinforced Thursday after the Associated Press projected Amish Shah’s victory in Arizona, flipping a Republican-held seat contested by former NFL kicker Jay Feely.

In Virginia, Democrat Shannon Taylor ousted Republican Rep. Rob Wittman, who had been in office since 2007.

Democrat Sam Forstag also became the first Democrat in decades to win a House seat in Montana, according to Politico.

The empty podium is seen after Maine Republican Senate candidate Sen. Susan Collins (R-ME) conceded to her opponent during a watch party at the Hilton Garden Inn on November 04, 2026, in Bangor, Maine. Collins lost to Maine Democratic Senate candidate Troy Jackson. (Photo by Joe Raedle/Getty Images)

Many House races have yet to be called by the Associated Press, but Democrats lead in most of them as they hold a comfortable House majority.

In the Senate, the Associated Press has called seven seats flipped to Democrats. The only two remaining races are both tight contests for Republican-held seats in Alaska and Mississippi, where Democrats are leading. (RELATED: Internet On Fire With The Jokes After Democrats Shellack Republicans In Midterms)

A similar map shows five governorships flipping to Democrats, with Democrats also leading in the two remaining races in Kansas and Alaska.
news.content:
با شمارش بیشتر نزدیک‌ترین رقابت‌ها از انتخابات روز سه‌شنبه، نتایج نشان می‌دهد که موج آبی واقعاً چقدر قوی است. در حالی که تا صبح روز بعد مشخص بود که دموکرات‌ها هم مجلس نمایندگان و هم سنا ایالات متحده را تصاحب کرده‌اند، بسیاری از رقابت‌ها هنوز فراخوانی نشده است. در زمان انتشار، آسوشیتدپرس 247 کرسی برای دموکرات ها و 153 کرسی برای جمهوری خواهان، به همراه 54 کرسی سنا برای دموکرات ها و 44 کرسی برای جمهوری خواهان را فراخوانده بود. (مرتبط: دستاوردهای دموکرات ها در جنوب یک تحقق عجیب و غریب از یک پیشگویی 60 ساله است)
برخی از جدیدترین پیکاپ‌های دموکرات‌ها در کارولینای شمالی، ویرجینیا و آریزونا هستند، زیرا رای‌دهندگان به مخالفت با جمهوری‌خواهان و رئیس‌جمهور آن، دونالد ترامپ، رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا می‌پردازند. طبق گزارش پولیتیکو، سه کرسی از چهار کرسی که دموکرات‌ها در مناطق کارولینای شمالی به دست آوردند که تحت تأثیر تقسیم‌بندی مجدد جمهوری‌خواهان قرار گرفتند، از قرمز به آبی تبدیل شدند. این پیروزی‌ها شامل پیروزی‌های سیریل جفرسون، پل بارینگر، و لیکشا ووماک دموکرات‌ها می‌شد. زمانی که دونالد ترامپ، رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا در تاریخ 2 نوامبر 2026 در واشنگتن دی سی سخنرانی می‌کند، یک زن تابلویی برای رای دادن به رنگ آبی در نزدیکی استخر بازتاب یادبود لینکلن در دست دارد. (عکس از کوین کارتر/گتی ایماژ) هر هشت ناحیه کارولینای شمالی که توسط آسوشیتدپرس فراخوانده شده بود به دموکرات ها رسید، در حالی که جمهوری خواهان تنها در چهار منطقه از شش ناحیه در حال شمارش پیشتاز بودند. پیشتازی دموکرات ها روز پنجشنبه پس از پیش بینی پیروزی آمیش شاه در آریزونا توسط آسوشیتدپرس تقویت شد و کرسی تحت کنترل جمهوری خواهان را تغییر داد.

[Screenshot/The Sage Steele Show]

Republican Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis criticized failed Republican Ohio gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy Thursday for not representing Ohioans.

DeSantis said on “The Sage Steele Show” that the Ohio Republican Party should have never nominated Ramaswamy because he does not represent Ohio’s workin- class, blue-collar electorate. He criticized Ramaswamy for supporting H-1B visas and pretending to appeal to the working class when he is a billionaire biotechnology entrepreneur.

“Ohio Governor! How bad did they beat Vivek? Like a drum! Now, part of that was Vivek, quite frankly,” DeSantis said. “I don’t know why they would have pushed him to be the candidate there … Ohio is a working-class state, very blue-collar. Vivek, he’s a tech guy, did this Alzheimer’s drug, and he wants to bring in people, foreign workers on visas. That is not the type of person that is going to sell.”

Governor @RonDeSantis nukes the awful @VivekGRamaswamy: “Ohio Governor! How bad did they beat Vivek? Like a drum! Now, part of that was Vivek, quite frankly. I don’t know why they would have pushed him to be the candidate there… Ohio is a working-class state, very blue-collar. Vivek, he’s a tech guy, did this fake Alzheimer’s drug, and he wants to bring in people, foreign workers on visas.”

Ramaswamy lost the governor’s race to Democratic Ohio Gov.-elect Amy Acton by a 52% to 44% margin. (RELATED: Ron DeSantis Says 2026 Midterms ‘Close To An Extinction-Level Event’ For GOP)

In 2014, Ramaswamy founded Roivant Sciences, a now-multinational biopharmaceutical and technology company which has a market cap of almost $29 billion.

Ramaswamy argued in a Dec. 26, 2024, X post that many companies are forced to turn to foreign talent because “American culture has venerated mediocrity” for the past few decades. He refused to answer any questions about H-1Bs during a September interview with the Daily Caller News Foundation.

Ohio lost roughly 300,000 manufacturing jobs between 1999 and 2025, according to Policy Matters Ohio. More than six-in-ten Ohioans believe the U.S. is on the wrong track, and the state’s voters rated the economy and inflation as their top concerns, an early September poll from Bowling Green State University (BGSU) found.

Ramaswamy faced backlash after his campaign released an ad featuring Acton’s estranged mother, who lost custody of Acton and her brother after she allegedly allowed her then-husband to abuse the governor-elect when she was a child.

DeSantis argued that Republicans lost the midterms because they failed to address affordability and government accountability. Before the results, he warned that Republicans would likely lose because of high gas prices and the Iran war.

“This midterm was a rebuke of the president and Congress…but, a lot of our voters stayed home because they were frustrated with the lack of productivity from Republicans in the House and Senate,” DeSantis said on Fox News’ “The Ingraham Angle.”

Democrats regained majorities in the House and Senate after voters soured over Trump’s handling of the economy, Iran war and corruption.

فرماندار جمهوری خواه فلوریدا، ران دیسانتیس، پنج شنبه از ویوک راماسوامی نامزد شکست خورده فرمانداری اوهایو به دلیل عدم نمایندگی اوهایو انتقاد کرد. دیسانتیس در برنامه "The Sage Steele Show" گفت که حزب جمهوری خواه اوهایو هرگز نباید راماسوامی را نامزد می کرد زیرا او نماینده طبقه کارگر و یقه آبی اوهایو نیست. او از راماسوامی به خاطر حمایت از ویزای H-1B و تظاهر به درخواست از طبقه کارگر در زمانی که یک میلیاردر کارآفرین بیوتکنولوژی است انتقاد کرد. دیسانتیس گفت: "فرماندار اوهایو! چقدر بد ویوک را زدند؟ مثل یک طبل! حالا، رک و پوست کنده، بخشی از آن Vivek بود." نمی‌دانم چرا او را به سمت نامزدی در آنجا تحت فشار قرار می‌دادند... اوهایو یک ایالت طبقه کارگر است، بسیار یقه آبی. ویوک، او یک فرد فناوری است، این داروی آلزایمر را مصرف کرد، و او می‌خواهد افراد، کارگران خارجی را با ویزا بیاورد. این آدمی نیست که بفروشد.»
فرماندار @RonDeSantis به @VivekGRamaswamy وحشتناک حمله اتمی می کند: «فرماندار اوهایو! چقدر ویوک را شکست دادند؟ مثل طبل! اکنون، کاملاً صادقانه، بخشی از آن Vivek بود. نمی‌دانم چرا او را تحت فشار قرار می‌دادند که در آنجا نامزد شود... اوهایو یک ایالت طبقه کارگر است، بسیار یقه آبی. ویوک، او یک مرد فناوری است، این داروی جعلی آلزایمر را انجام داد و می‌خواهد افراد، کارگران خارجی را با ویزا بیاورد.
راماسوامی رقابت فرمانداری را به امی اکتون فرماندار منتخب دموکرات اوهایو با اختلاف 52 درصد نسبت به 44 درصد شکست داد. (مرتبط: ران دیسانتیس می گوید میان ترم های 2026 "نزدیک به یک رویداد در سطح انقراض"

news.originalContent:
The Republican midterm rout is helping shape who leads Israel next, as Netanyahu’s US ties turn toxic.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has long sold himself as the leader who will ensure that ties with the United States, the country’s most important ally, remain strong. The endorsement he received in the run-up to Israel’s parliamentary elections last month from US President Donald Trump added to that perception, in the same year as Washington and Tel Aviv jointly went to war against Iran.

Then came the US midterm elections, and the disastrous performance of Trump’s Republican Party. Early analysis of why the Republicans lost so badly has in part focused on that war with Iran, and the United States’s relationship with Israel. Both were highlighted by US Vice President JD Vance.

Suddenly, Netanyahu’s argument that he is the US-Israel relationship’s secret sauce looks much weaker. If anything, it can be argued that Netanyahu, and his policies – resulting in a genocidal war in Gaza, the Iran war, and numerous attacks in the wider region – have made Israel politically toxic in the US.

Many Israelis are now worried that the country can no longer rely on unquestioned support from the US. And as Israel’s political leaders jockey to try and form a government following the parliamentary elections, the opposition has laid the blame squarely at Netanyahu’s feet, and argued that it is another reason he should not be allowed to form the next government.

Yair Lapid, a former Israeli prime minister whose party is a member of the bloc seeking to unseat Netanyahu, stressed his own ties to members of the US Congress in a social media post. He added that he believed US voters were not so much against Israel as “against extremist ministers who say crazy things. They’re against settler violence; they’re against a government they don’t understand; they’re mainly against Netanyahu — for them, anything connected to him is toxic”.

Avigdor Lieberman, another opposition leader, echoed what many in Israel are said to suspect: that Trump’s election-day announcement that US military aid to Israel would end had been traded for his endorsement of the prime minister. “The price of Trump’s support for Netanyahu – $3.8bn dollars a year,” Lieberman wrote on social media.

“With America stopping the money it has channelled to Israel for so many years, the defence budget, already 7 percent of GDP, will have to rise. Israelis will feel it in their pocket. But then, you can’t be a rogue state and expect things to continue as before,” Ahron Bregman, an Israeli security analyst and senior teaching fellow at King’s College London, said. “In Israel, Netanyahu continues to do what he has always done so well, turning one segment of the population against the other. He’s now trying to delegitimise the Arabs by saying they stole the elections, in order to stop the opposition having the Arabs as partners.”

Israel’s general election on October 27 left Netanyahu’s right-wing bloc with 53 seats in parliament, eight short of the 61 needed to form a government.

The opposition bloc led by former army chief of staff Gadi Eisenkot got 48 seats, while the Arab-led parties – the United Arab List (Ra’am) and the Joint List – have 19 seats. The Arab-led parties have both said that they will support Eisenkot for prime minister.

Eisenkot and other opposition leaders have rejected suggestions of a unity government with Netanyahu, leaving him without a clear path to a majority.

It is now up to Israeli President Isaac Herzog to nominate a politician to form a government, but he has yet to do so.

As things stand, Eisenkot’s self-styled Zionist bloc, which has previously ruled out serving alongside the Arab-led parties, stands to benefit from their backing from outside the government, despite Netanyahu’s attacks.

Eisenkot’s prospects were boosted further on Thursday when United Torah Judaism (UTJ), Netanyahu’s longtime ultra-Orthodox ally, declined for the first time since 2009 to recommend him or anyone else to form a government, an apparent defection that weakens the prime minister’s position while giving a boost to his opponents.

But Eisenkot replacing Netanyahu as Israel’s prime minister does not necessarily mean that he will be able to reverse Israel’s declining popularity in the US. An April Pew Research Center poll suggested that public attitudes in the US are as negative towards Israel as they are towards Netanyahu, noted pollster Shibley Telhami, the director of the University of Maryland Critical Issues Poll.

“Our own poll found that most Americans would not change their view of Israel, even if there is a new government without Netanyahu,” said Telhami. “Any government of Israel would be swimming against the rising public tide … I don’t think any government of Israel could return relations back to where they were five years ago.”
news.content: شکست میان‌دوره‌ای جمهوری‌خواهان به شکل‌گیری رهبری بعدی اسرائیل کمک می‌کند، زیرا روابط نتانیاهو با آمریکا مسموم می‌شود. بنیامین نتانیاهو، نخست‌وزیر، مدت‌هاست که خود را به عنوان رهبری فروخته است که تضمین می‌کند که روابط با ایالات متحده، مهمترین متحد این کشور، قوی باقی بماند. تأییدیه ای که او در آستانه انتخابات پارلمانی اسرائیل در ماه گذشته از سوی دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا دریافت کرد، در همان سالی که واشنگتن و تل آویو مشترکاً علیه ایران جنگیدند، به این تصور افزود. سپس انتخابات میان دوره ای آمریکا و عملکرد فاجعه بار حزب جمهوری خواه ترامپ آمد. تحلیل اولیه در مورد اینکه چرا جمهوری خواهان اینقدر شکست خوردند تا حدی بر آن جنگ با ایران و رابطه ایالات متحده با اسرائیل متمرکز بود. هر دو توسط جی دی ونس، معاون رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده برجسته شدند. ناگهان، استدلال نتانیاهو مبنی بر اینکه او سس محرمانه روابط ایالات متحده و اسرائیل است بسیار ضعیف تر به نظر می رسد. در هر صورت، می‌توان ادعا کرد که نتانیاهو و سیاست‌های او - که منجر به جنگ نسل‌کشی در غزه، جنگ ایران و حملات متعدد در منطقه شد - اسرائیل را از نظر سیاسی در ایالات متحده سمی کرده است. بسیاری از اسرائیلی‌ها اکنون نگران هستند که این کشور دیگر نمی‌تواند به حمایت بی‌چون و چرای آمریکا تکیه کند. و در حالی که رهبران سیاسی اسرائیل در تلاش برای تشکیل دولت پس از انتخابات پارلمانی هستند، اپوزیسیون تقصیر را مستقیماً به پای نتانیاهو انداخته و استدلال می‌کند که این دلیل دیگری است که او نباید اجازه تشکیل دولت بعدی را داشته باشد. یایر لاپید، اسرائیلی سابق

news.originalContent:
New Democratic Congress expected to probe Trump Justice Department civil rights office’s handling of Epstein files and ICE killings.

As President Donald Trump’s administration prepares for a flurry of congressional investigations into shootings by immigration agents and the Jeffrey Epstein files, the top official in charge of the United States Department of Justice’s civil rights division has resigned.

US Attorney General Todd Blanche on Thursday confirmed Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon’s departure in a post on social media.

“Today, I accepted the resignation of Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon,” Blanche wrote on X. “She has defended the civil liberties of every American and enforced the law without fear or favor.”

A top Trump ally, Dhillon was confirmed to her role in April 2025 and has overseen a dramatic overhaul of the Justice Department’s civil rights division, which is tasked with enforcing anti-discrimination laws. Hundreds of former Justice Department officials penned a letter last December decrying the “destruction” of the agency division under Trump.

Dhillon is the first high-ranking official to resign from the Trump administration since US Democrats swept both chambers of the US Congress in the country’s pivotal midterm elections on Tuesday.

Democratic congressman Robert Garcia, who will likely become the new chair of the powerful House of Representatives Committee on Oversight and Accountability, pledged on Wednesday to take on four major investigations, including abuses of power by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents and the Epstein files.

Dhillon reportedly told her staff earlier this year that her office, which has typically been charged with investigating law enforcement killings by police officers, would not be looking into the fatal shootings of two US citizens – Renee Good and Alex Pretti – who were gunned down by ICE agents in Minneapolis.

In May, Garcia accused the administration of continuing to shield Trump from scrutiny related to unreleased documents tied to the Epstein investigation

During a closed-door hearing in which Blanche’s predecessor, Pam Bondi, was asked by lawmakers about the case, the California Democrat Garcia alleged Dhillon repeatedly intervened to block questions about the president’s connection to the release of the files.

The Justice Department referred Al Jazeera to Blanche’s social media post when asked when Dhillon submitted her resignation. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
news.content: انتظار می رود کنگره دموکرات جدید درباره رسیدگی به پرونده های اپشتین و قتل های ICE توسط دفتر حقوق مدنی وزارت دادگستری ترامپ تحقیق کند. در حالی که دولت دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا در حال آماده شدن برای تحقیقات گسترده کنگره در مورد تیراندازی توسط ماموران مهاجرت و پرونده های جفری اپستین است، بالاترین مقام مسئول بخش حقوق مدنی وزارت دادگستری ایالات متحده از سمت خود کناره گیری کرد. تاد بلانچ، دادستان کل ایالات متحده روز پنجشنبه در پستی در شبکه های اجتماعی استعفای دستیار دادستان کل هرمیت دیلون را تایید کرد. بلانچ در X نوشت: "امروز استعفای هارمیت دیلون، دستیار دادستان کل را پذیرفتم." دیلون که یکی از متحدان ارشد ترامپ بود، در آوریل 2025 نقش خود را تایید کرد و بر بازنگری چشمگیر بخش حقوق مدنی وزارت دادگستری نظارت داشت که وظیفه اجرای قوانین ضد تبعیض را بر عهده دارد. صدها تن از مقامات سابق وزارت دادگستری در دسامبر گذشته نامه ای نوشتند و در آن «تخریب» بخش آژانس در دوران ترامپ را محکوم کردند. دیلون اولین مقام بلندپایه‌ای است که از دولت ترامپ پس از پیروزی دموکرات‌های آمریکا در انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای مهم این کشور در روز سه‌شنبه، از دولت ترامپ استعفا می‌دهد. رابرت گارسیا، نماینده دموکرات کنگره، که احتمالاً رئیس جدید کمیته قدرتمند مجلس نمایندگان در امور نظارت و پاسخگویی خواهد شد، متعهد شد که چهار مجلس را بر عهده بگیرد.

news.originalContent:
US first lady hosts Russian, Ukrainian officials at the White House, urges two sides to build on recent local truce.

United States First Lady Melania Trump has urged Russia and Ukraine to build on a recent localised ceasefire and seek a more “enduring” peace, as she hosted officials from both countries at the White House.

Melania Trump spoke on Thursday at an event that the White House said is believed to be “the first time in American history that a First Lady has personally brought representatives of two nations at war to the White House for diplomacy”.

Those attending included Kirill Dmitriev, a special envoy of Russian President Vladimir Putin; Yana Lantratova, Russia’s human rights commissioner; David Arakhamia, leader of the Servant of the People party in Ukraine’s parliament; and Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine’s parliamentary human rights commissioner.

“Together, we can create something more enduring than a temporary ceasefire,” Mrs. Trump said, urging both sides to see the humanitarian truce in Oleshky “as a spark in a world of darkness”.

She said her role as “exclusive intermediary” was set out in written agreements signed by both countries, and that she was involved in every stage of the planning, including reviewing de-mining plans and evacuation routes.

Ukrainian representatives presented the US first lady with the Order of Princess Olga, first class, which President Volodymyr Zelenskyy awarded her earlier this week. She also gave the most senior officials present letters she had written to Putin and Zelenskyy.

The six-day truce covered the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky in Ukraine’s Kherson region and the surrounding area, and allowed aid deliveries and the evacuation of nearly 800 people.

An estimated 2,000 civilians had been left in the city. It was the longest multi-day truce between Russia and Ukraine since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022, and the first joint relief operation in four years and eight months.

The White House said Melania Trump mediated the truce, though Pope Leo XIV also pressed both sides to allow aid and evacuations, and that the two accounts of who brokered it have diverged.

The truce expired last Sunday with no extension, a day before a Russian bombing of an aid distribution point in Komyshuvakha, in the Zaporizhia region, killed at least 40 people, according to Ukrainian President Zelenskyy.

New US-brokered talks between Russia and Ukraine are expected to take place in Abu Dhabi on November 10 and 11.
news.content: بانوی اول ایالات متحده میزبان مقامات روسی و اوکراینی در کاخ سفید است، از دو طرف می‌خواهد که بر اساس آتش‌بس محلی اخیر پیشروی کنند. ملانیا ترامپ، بانوی اول ایالات متحده، از روسیه و اوکراین خواسته است که بر اساس آتش‌بس محلی اخیر و به دنبال صلح «پایدارتر» باشند، زیرا او میزبان مقامات هر دو کشور در کاخ سفید بود. ملانیا ترامپ روز پنجشنبه در مراسمی صحبت کرد که به گفته کاخ سفید «اولین بار در تاریخ آمریکا است که یک بانوی اول شخصا نمایندگان دو کشور در حال جنگ را برای دیپلماسی به کاخ سفید آورده است». از جمله کریل دیمیتریف، فرستاده ویژه ولادیمیر پوتین، رئیس جمهور روسیه، شرکت کنندگان بودند. یانا لانتراتووا، کمیسر حقوق بشر روسیه؛ دیوید آراخامیا، رهبر حزب خدمتگزار مردم در پارلمان اوکراین؛ و دیمیترو لوبینتس، کمیسر حقوق بشر پارلمانی اوکراین. خانم خانم "با هم می توانیم چیزی پایدارتر از آتش بس موقت ایجاد کنیم." ترامپ گفت و از هر دو طرف خواست آتش‌بس بشردوستانه در اولشکی را «جرقه‌ای در دنیای تاریکی» ببینند. او گفت که نقش او به‌عنوان «واسطه انحصاری» در توافق‌نامه‌های کتبی امضا شده توسط هر دو کشور مشخص شده است و او در هر مرحله از برنامه‌ریزی، از جمله بررسی طرح‌های مین‌زدایی و مسیرهای تخلیه مشارکت داشته است. نمایندگان اوکراین نشان پرنسس اولگا درجه یک را به بانوی اول آمریکا اهدا کردند که رئیس جمهور ولودیمیر زلنسکی اوایل این هفته به او اعطا کرد. او همچنین بلندپایه ترین مقامات را نیز حاضر کرد

news.originalContent:
Some Democratic senators – and the very voters that swept them into power – are demanding new leadership.

After Democrats delivered a once-in-a-generation midterm thumping of Republicans in the United States midterms, their current leader, Chuck Schumer, has expressed confidence he will helm his party’s larger-than-expected majority in the US Senate.

“I’ll be re-elected as majority leader,” the New York Democrat told reporters in Washington on Wednesday.

But as calls for change reached a fever pitch among voters in this week’s pivotal elections, not every newly elected Senate Democrat is open to the idea of having Schumer, a 75-year-old stalwart of the chamber, reprise his role as the head of their agenda.

At least seven incoming Democratic freshmen have publicly suggested – or said outright – they will not commit to supporting Schumer in next month’s leadership vote:

Jackson has openly questioned Schumer’s ability to connect with working-class voters, while Flanagan’s staff has said the senator-elect wants “a progressive champion” who will shepherd Democrats through the final two years of Donald Trump’s presidency and into 2028.

New members, like El-Sayed, may not be won over after Schumer backed the former public health official’s opponent, Haley Stevens, in Michigan’s Democratic primary.

Schumer, the first Jewish Senate leader, has often found himself at the centre of brewing cultural and foreign-policy debates within his party.

In remarks that were posted online in February, Schumer told Jewish leaders in New York City one of his core duties was “to fight for aid to Israel”.

“We delivered more security assistance to Israel, our ally, under my leadership than ever, ever before”, he said. “We will keep doing that.”

Schumer has also faced fierce criticism for not doing enough to block Trump’s cabinet members from being confirmed. Some have even chastised the leader for retreating during last year’s government shutdown after he backed a Republican bill to reopen federal agencies without getting anything in return.

Critics in his party, including California Governor Gavin Newsom, called that a “capitulation” that abandoned key Democratic priorities, like healthcare subsidies. Michigan Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib said Schumer should have stepped down as leader over the matter.

The Democratic leader said on Wednesday the party’s new Senate plan would include launching investigations into the Trump administration, challenging the president’s agenda and ending his war in Iran.

However, that’s not good enough for some current members, like Van Hollen, who recently told Bloomberg that Democrats should not commit to Schumer without promises of a “bold agenda”.

Before Tuesday’s election, a senior campaign staff member for Senator Jon Ossoff, who was easily re-elected to his seat, would not say whether the Georgia Democrat would back Schumer.

“I do not have an answer,” the Ossoff source told Al Jazeera. “We can do all the fantasy football stuff later.”

When Democratic lawmakers return to Washington next week, voters and Democratic-aligned groups will likely pressure them to support an alternative candidate.

After calling for new leadership after the election, Indivisible, a progressive US-based organisation that bills itself as a movement “to stop the rise of authoritarianism”, released a memo on Thursday detailing their opposition to Schumer.

“Everyone with a Democratic senator – including those with newly-elected senators on their way to DC – should be demanding a contested leadership election, not a cleared field for Schumer”, the memo read.

“Any Democrat who is considering business as usual, or unwilling to fight at a level that matches the public’s demand for action – is not qualified to lead the party at this moment. Who leads the party in this era must be an open question, not a coronation. It’s time to define what the next era of the Democratic Party will be.”

Al Jazeera asked Schumer’s office how he plans to address those concerns and whether he is speaking with frustrated Democrats, but it has not yet responded.

To be re-elected, Schumer needs a simple majority of the Democratic Senate caucus, projected to comprise 54-56 members, and Schumer, who previously served as majority leader during the duration of former President Biden’s term in office, still has allies he can count on.

One of those is Democratic Senator Cory Booker of New Jersey, who told ABC on Wednesday that he commended Schumer’s handling of the midterms, saying he delivered “one of the most historic sweeps” for the party.

“We’re gonna have a family discussion,” Booker said. “But I think America should give … Chuck Schumer his due for what we were able to achieve.”

When asked Wednesday about building criticism of his leadership, Schumer demurred, saying Tuesday’s elections were “not about” him.

“This is about the American people and what they want and what they need and what we can do to help them. Plain and simple”.

برخی از سناتورهای دموکرات - و همان رای دهندگانی که آنها را به قدرت رساندند - خواستار رهبری جدید هستند. پس از آنکه دموکرات ها یک بار در میان دوره ای جمهوری خواهان را در میان دوره ای ایالات متحده شکست دادند، رهبر فعلی آنها، چاک شومر، ابراز اطمینان کرده است که اکثریت بیش از حد انتظار حزب خود را در سناتور ایالات متحده رهبری خواهد کرد. دموکرات نیویورک روز چهارشنبه به خبرنگاران در واشنگتن گفت: «من مجدداً به عنوان رهبر اکثریت انتخاب خواهم شد.» اما از آنجایی که درخواست‌ها برای تغییر در میان رأی‌دهندگان در انتخابات مهم این هفته به تب و تاب رسیده است، هر دموکرات تازه منتخب سنا نمی‌پذیرد که شومر، یک 75 ساله سرسخت سناتور خود را به عنوان رئیس جدید مجلس سنا داشته باشد. حداقل هفت دانشجوی تازه وارد دموکرات علناً پیشنهاد کرده اند - یا صریحاً گفته اند - آنها متعهد به حمایت از شومر در رای رهبری ماه آینده نخواهند بود:
جکسون آشکارا توانایی شومر برای ارتباط با رای دهندگان طبقه کارگر را زیر سوال برده است، در حالی که کارکنان فلانگان گفته اند که سناتور منتخب "قهرمان مترقی" می خواهد که دموکرات ها را در دو سال آخر ریاست جمهوری دونالد ترامپ و تا سال 2028 شبان کند. پس از حمایت شومر از رقیب هیلی استیونز، رقیب مقام سابق بهداشت عمومی، هیلی استیونز، در انتخابات مقدماتی دموکرات میشیگان، ممکن است اعضای جدید، مانند السید، جذب نشوند. شومر، اولین رهبر یهودی سنا، اغلب خود را در مرکز بحث های فرهنگی و سیاست خارجی در حزب خود می بیند. در اظهاراتی که در اینترنت منتشر شده است.

news.originalContent:
Iranian forces say five oil tankers and a tugboat have caught fire in several incidents in the Strait of Hormuz.

At least five tankers have been damaged in the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian forces said, making clear that shipping would remain in peril as long as the United States and Israel’s war on the country is unresolved.

Since the war on Iran began in late February, Tehran has severely restricted traffic through the strategic waterway, which normally carries about one-fifth of global oil consumption.

“Last night … a large oil tanker attempting to pass through the illegal passageway south of the Strait of Hormuz suffered a fire after striking a mine and was brought to a halt,” Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) told the Fars news agency on Thursday.

“Another supertanker was halted by a massive fire while exiting the eastern Strait of Hormuz. A tugboat that had approached the supertanker to extinguish the fire also caught fire,” the IRGC added.

The Iranian army later said three more tankers were hit by naval mines and caught fire.

“Early this morning, a violating oil tanker – navigating through an unsafe area east of the Strait of Hormuz – caught fire and came to a halt after striking a naval mine,” the army said, according to the official IRNA news agency.

“Today at around noon, two more oil tankers struck naval mines and caught fire in the unsafe waters east of the Strait of Hormuz,” said another army statement carried by IRNA.

Separately, the British military said a tanker was struck by two projectiles off Qatar’s coast.

The vessel was hit about 50 nautical miles (about 93 kilometres) north of Qatar’s ⁠Madinat ash-Shamal on Wednesday at 23:20 GMT, the ⁠United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said on Thursday.

UKMTO did not identify the tanker or which country’s flag it was sailing under. There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the attack.

In an incident last week, a Qatari tanker was hit by “unidentified objects” while sailing in the Gulf.

The liquefied natural gas (LNG) carrier Al Mayeda was hit on October 30, the Qatar Gas Transport Company (Nakilat) said on Sunday.

No crew members were injured, and there ‌was no environmental impact, the company said, adding that the vessel remained ‌safe and ‌operational while the impact was being assessed.

Attacks on tankers in the Gulf are still running close to a record pace.

UKMTO said in a report last month that it was “struggling to accurately report” the true number of attacks as the majority of ships now refuse to report them.

Qatar has stepped up mediation efforts to resume talks on ending the war in recent days.

Qatar’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs’ spokesperson said on Tuesday that ⁠both sides were reviewing proposals ⁠put forward by mediators, with talks continuing.

But unnamed Pentagon officials and military commanders told The New York Times on Wednesday that thousands of US air and naval forces on more than a dozen ships and at bases around the Middle East and in the US are poised to resume major combat operations against Iran on President Donald Trump’s orders.

Iranian government and military leaders, however, have warned of repercussions if the US or Israel pursue further military action.

On Wednesday, Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said there should not be “even the slightest inclination towards submission” to the US, which he said would remain hostile towards Iran no matter which party was in power.

IRGC Ground Force commander Brigadier General Mohammad Karami said on Wednesday that the continuation of “hostile and brutal actions by Iran’s enemies” would lead to “further Iranian victories and greater national pride”, while accelerating the expulsion of foreign powers from the region and the collapse of Israel.
news.content: نیروهای ایرانی می‌گویند پنج نفتکش و یک یدک‌کش در چندین حادثه در تنگه هرمز آتش گرفته‌اند. نیروهای ایرانی گفتند که حداقل پنج نفتکش در تنگه هرمز آسیب دیده‌اند و تصریح کردند که تا زمانی که جنگ ایالات متحده و اسرائیل علیه این کشور حل نشده باشد، کشتی‌ها در خطر باقی خواهند ماند. از زمان آغاز جنگ علیه ایران در اواخر فوریه، تهران تردد از طریق آبراه استراتژیک را که معمولاً حدود یک پنجم مصرف جهانی نفت را تامین می‌کند، به شدت محدود کرده است. سپاه پاسداران انقلاب اسلامی افزود: «یک سوپرتانکر دیگر در حین خروج از تنگه شرقی هرمز بر اثر آتش سوزی گسترده متوقف شد. یک یدک‌کش که برای خاموش کردن آتش به سوپرتانکر نزدیک شده بود نیز آتش گرفت.» ارتش ایران بعداً اعلام کرد سه نفتکش دیگر مورد اصابت مین‌های دریایی قرار گرفتند و آتش گرفتند. به گزارش خبرگزاری رسمی ایرنا، ارتش اعلام کرد: اوایل صبح امروز یک نفتکش متخلف که از منطقه ناامن شرق تنگه هرمز عبور می کرد، آتش گرفت و پس از اصابت به مین دریایی متوقف شد. توسط ایرنا. به طور جداگانه، مایل بریتانیا

news.originalContent:
Former Trump lawyer Alina Habba laughed off a question from CBS News about whether she would consider donating fees she made in a reported $50 million pardon deal to President Trump’s library.

Habba reportedly signed a four-year, $50 million agreement to become general counsel for Concord Partners, a company established in October 2025 by the daughter of Venezuelan-Italian banker Julio Herrera Velutini, while serving as a U.S. attorney and senior adviser in New Jersey and the Department of Justice. She officially began the role at Concord on Jan. 1, and Herrera Velutini, who was charged by the Biden DOJ for his role in a Puerto Rican bribery scheme, later received a full presidential pardon from Trump on Jan. 15. (RELATED: Pete Hegseth’s Wife Gets In On Trump 2.0’s Lucrative Swamp Bonanza)

For a report on Trump’s presidential library, CBS News asked Habba whether she would consider donating the pardon deal fees to the library or another Trump-related entity. Habba responded “haha” before quickly deleting the text and declining to comment, according to CBS News.

Former Trump lawyer Alina Habba - asked by @CBSNews if she will donate her fees from a contract tied to the family of a businessman Mr. Trump pardoned - responded to the text with a “haha” reaction then removed it Comes after @tylerpager reporting in NYT on Trump telling aides/allies she should donate

Trump publicly rebuked Habba in late October, telling reporters at a Mar-a-Lago Halloween party that Habba entering into the deal was “totally obnoxious and outrageous.”

“I thought it was terrible,” he said. “I told her, and I said, ‘I don’t want her paid.’ I thought we had somebody speak to the people that did it, and she used her relationship to do that. And it was far too much.”

The president also criticized Habba privately among aides and allies when he learned of the deal, first reported by The New York Times, and said that she should donate a portion of the money to his future presidential library. Trump, however, said on Halloween that he was not expecting Habba to do it but suggested someone from Herrera Velutini’s family should.

“I expect maybe the people,” he said of the family. “I don’t know if anybody wants to make it. But it’s unacceptable what she did.”

Dhillon’s resignation makes her the first high-profile official to depart President Donald Trump’s administration after the disastrous midterm cycle. Dhillon served as the Assistant Attorney General within the DOJ’s civil rights unit. (RELATED: Trump Brought Back America First — The Daily Caller Is Taking On The Establishment Trying To Hijack It)

“Serving my country as AAG for Civil Rights has been the honor of a lifetime,” Dhillon said in a statement on X. “We ushered in the downfall of illegal DEI, we fought to protect women and girls’ sports, and so much more. I want to thank President Trump for giving me this opportunity. I look forward to what’s next!”

This comes just days after Republicans endured a bruising midterm defeat, with Democrats flipping seven Senate seats and dozens of House seats so far.

“She has defended the civil liberties of every American and enforced the law without fear or favor,” Attorney General Todd Blanche said in a post on X. “The Department is grateful for her dedicated public service, and we wish her every success in her future endeavors,” Blanche added.

“I wasn’t asked to resign,” Dhillon told Fox News Digital. “I resigned 3 weeks ago, and Susie asked me to please wait until after the midterms.”

Dhillon first assumed the role in April 2025 following a party-line confirmation vote in the Senate. During her tenure, Dhillon set her sights on dismantling Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI), aided victims of religious discrimination, and advocated for biological women against transgender ideology.

Dhillon launched investigations into various universities for allegedly discriminating against white and asian students through affirmative action programs. She also challenged race-based hiring practices at various colleges, particularly within the University of California system.

Dhillon also sued several states to access their voter registration information in an effort to identify potential noncitizens.

She previously served as a campaign lawyer for Trump and founded her own California-based law firm, Dhillon Law Group.

This story is developing and will be updated.

College Republicans’ populist faction made a stunning break with President Donald Trump over Tuesday’s blue tsunami and the administration’s broken promises.

The College Republican Patriot Coalition (CRPC), a consortium of college Republican groups across the country that align with America First, “unequivocally” laid the blame for the GOP’s historic losses “at the feet of the Trump administration and the Republican Party.” (RELATED: ‘No Downside’: Iran War Hawks Get A Midterm Reality Check)

“This outcome was no accident,” the group said in a statement. “It is the predictable result of an administration and a party that campaigned on America First and governed as though we would wait forever. This lame duck Republican government failed to do what it promised, and manipulated and insulted its base for sounding the alarms for two years.”

America First is the ONLY way forward. Official CRPC statement on the results of last night’s midterm election: https://t.co/GKOuzCAXNe

“Millions of us young Americans knocked on doors, made calls, and cast first-time ballots for a movement that promised affordability, mass deportations, reindustrialization, and an end to foreign wars,” CRPC continued. “Instead, we received a war on behalf of Israel, stunted deportations, and a flailing economy. On all fronts, the Republican Party and the Trump administration in particular has betrayed us.”

CRPC urged Trump to “purge his administration of those who have not and will not deliver on the mandate voters gave him in 2024,” immediately end the Iran War and focus instead on the affordability crisis that has led to young Americans “being priced out of their own country.” (RELATED: Ron DeSantis Says 2026 Midterms ‘Close To An Extinction-Level Event’ For GOP)

The group also singled out the “disastrous and unintelligible” Iran War as the administration’s “greatest betrayal.”

“President Trump promised ‘no new wars,’ and millions of us believed him,” CRPC said. “This administration broke that promise and dragged us into another endless conflict with Iran at the urging of Israel.”

“Yesterday’s defeat was not inflicted by the left and is not the fault of the Republican base, but lies squarely at the feet of this administration’s broken promises,” the group concluded. “Americans deserve more than broken promises. We deserve a true champion that will put America first.”

news.originalContent:
منبع تصویر، Anadolu via Getty Images

بنابر اعلام مقام‌های اردن، یک مامور امنیتی در امان، پایتخت این کشور امروز (پنجشنبه)  با چاقو کشته شده است؛ یک مامور دیگر هم در این حمله مجروح شده است. مقام‌های اردن این حمله را «تروریستی» خواندند.

اداره امنیت عمومی اردن در بیانیه‌ای ضمن تایید این خبر، این مامور امنیتی را سرجوخه جواد علی خلف السلایطه معرفی کرد.

این نهاد گفته است که مامور دیگری هم در این حمله مجروح شده است.

مقام‌های اردنی می‌گویند که این حمله در مقابل سفارت سریلانکا رخ داده و در جریان آن، قربانی با یک «شیء تیز» مورد اصابت قرار گرفته است.

اداره امنیت عمومی اردن اعلام کرد که مامور آسیب دیده به سرعت به بیمارستان منتقل شد، اما بعدا بر اثر جراحت  درگذشت.

این نهاد افزود که یک گشت پلیس در آن نزدیکی بلافاصله وارد عمل شد و مهاجم را دستگیر کرد.

مامور دومی که در این حادثه مجروح شد، هنگامی که قصد مداخله داشت از ناحیه صورت آسیب دید و در حال حاضر وضعیتی پایدار دارد.

اداره امنیت عمومی اردن اعلام کرد که نهادهای امنیتی در حال انجام تحقیقات در این باره هستند.

این حمله چند روز پس از آن رخ داد که افراد مسلح با یورش به یک کلیسای ارتدوکس یونان در استان کرک اردن، ۹ نفر را کشتند و ۲۵ نفر دیگر را زخمی کردند.

روز سه‌شنبه، سه مرد در ارتباط با آن حمله، به ارتکاب جرایم مرتبط با تروریسم متهم شدند.

مقام‌های اردن، مظنونان حمله به کلیسا را پیروان یک ایدئولوژی اسلام‌گرای تندرو توصیف کردند.

این حمله اردن را شوکه کرد؛ کشوری که در آن مسیحیان حدود سه درصد از جمعیت دارای اکثریت مسلمان را تشکیل می‌دهند.

بر اساس قانون مبارزه با تروریسم در اردن، محکومیت در خصوص سنگین‌ترین اتهام، یعنی ارتکاب اقدامات تروریستی منجر به مرگ، مجازات اعدام در پی دارد.

ملک عبدالله، پادشاه اردن، روز دوشنبه گفت که به تروریست‌ها اجازه داده نخواهد شد وحدت و امنیت کشور را تهدید کنند؛ این سخنان پس از حمله مرگبار به کلیسای ارتدوکس بود.

برج ایفل هم به روی بازدیدکنندگان بسته شده است.

اتحادیه‌ها  که برای مطالبه افزایش حقوق، اعتصاب عمومی اعلام کرده‌اند، می‌گویند که انتظار دارند هشتصد هزار نفر در خیابان‌های سراسر کشور تظاهرات کنند.

ائتلافی از اتحادیه‌های کارگری از کارگران، بازنشستگان و جوانان خواسته‌اند تا به اعتصابات روز پنجشنبه بپیوندند و بدین‌وسیله فشار بر دولت را افزایش دهند.

آن‌ها به‌ویژه خواستار افزایش حداقل دستمزد هستند که در حال حاضر ۱۲/۳۱  یورو در ساعت است.

دولت تلاش کرده است با آزادسازی ۱۰ میلیون بشکه گازوئیل از ذخایر استراتژیک و کاهش بهای سوخت، خشم عمومی ناشی از افزایش قیمت‌ها را فرو بنشاند اما اعتراض‌ها همچنان ادامه دارد.

رهبران اتحادیه‌ها انتقاد کرده‌اند که راهپیمایی‌های اخیر از مرکز پاریس دور نگه داشته شده‌اند؛ این امر به دلیل خشونت‌هایی است که در تاریخ ۱۷ اکتبر در شهرها و مناطق مختلف رخ داد و به غارت بیش از ۲۰۰۰ فروشگاه و به آتش کشیده شدن بناهای تاریخی انجامید.

در اعتراض‌های آن روز، حدود ۵۵۰ هزار نفر شرکت کرده بودند و بیش از ۲۵۰۰ نفر بازداشت شده بودند. صدها فروشگاه و ساختمان آسیب دیدند و خسارت‌های واردشده صدها میلیون یورو برآورد شده بود.

وزیر کشور فرانسه به سه خطر احتمالی برای تظاهرات امروز اشاره کرده است: گروه‌های چپ‌گرای افراطی موسوم به «بلوک‌های سیاه»، غارت و چپاول، و همچنین راهپیمایی‌های خودجوش و بدون مجوز اتحادیه‌ها.

بسیج گسترده نیروها در اوایل این هفته، تعطیلات هفتگی اروپا، با خشونت نسبتاً کمی همراه بود و وزیر کشور فرانسه اعلام کرد که امروز، پنجشنبه، نیز استقرار پلیس در همان مقیاس خواهد بود.

بیش از ۳۲۰ هزار نفر در سومین تعطیلات هفتگی متوالی از اعتراضات عمدتا مسالمت‌آمیز شرکت کرده و در شهرهای مختلف خواستار اقدام دولت برای کاهش هزینه زندگی و بهبود خدمات عمومی ضعیف، به‌ویژه در بخش آموزش، شده بودند.

هزاران پلیس در سراسر فرانسه مستقر شده بودند که در برخی شهرها به معترضان گاز اشک‌آور شلیک کردند.

پس از درگیری‌ با پلیس در تولوز و لیون و مارسی، بیش از ۵۰۰ نفر هم بازداشت شده بودند.

موج تازه ناآرامی‌ها در حالی دولت فرانسه را با چالشی جدی روبه‌رو کرده که حدود شش ماه تا انتخابات ریاست‌جمهوری این کشور باقی مانده است و سیاستمداران مخالف، دولت امانوئل مکرون را مسئول تشدید نارضایتی‌های اجتماعی و اقتصادی می‌دانند.

news.title: رونالدو، اسطوره فوتبال پرتغال، از تیم ملی خداحافظی کرد
news.originalSummary:
کریستیانو رونالدو، اسطوره فوتبال پرتغال، رسما از تیم ملی کشورش خداحافظی کرد.

این مهاجم ۴۱ ساله از زمان نخستین بازی خود در سال ۲۰۰۳، ۱۴۶ گل برای تیم ملی پرتغال به ثمر رسانده و ۲۳۴ بازی ملی انجام داده است که هر دو رکوردی جهانی محسوب می‌شوند.

رونالدو در ماه سپتامبر، پس از آن که به او گفته شد که در دیدار لیگ ملت‌های اروپا مقابل دانمارک در ترکیب اصلی قرار نخواهد گرفت، اردوی تیم ملی پرتغال را ترک کرد.

news.originalContent:
کریستیانو رونالدو، اسطوره فوتبال پرتغال، رسما از تیم ملی کشورش خداحافظی کرد.

این مهاجم ۴۱ ساله از زمان نخستین بازی خود در سال ۲۰۰۳، ۱۴۶ گل برای تیم ملی پرتغال به ثمر رسانده و ۲۳۴ بازی ملی انجام داده است که هر دو رکوردی جهانی محسوب می‌شوند.

رونالدو در ماه سپتامبر، پس از آن که به او گفته شد که در دیدار لیگ ملت‌های اروپا مقابل دانمارک در ترکیب اصلی قرار نخواهد گرفت، اردوی تیم ملی پرتغال را ترک کرد.

رونالدو در ویدیویی که در صفحه اینستاگرام خود منتشر کرد، گفت: «مردم پرتغال، زمان آن رسیده است که پیراهن شماره ۷ تیم ملی کشورمان را به نسل بعد واگذار کنم.»

«هرگز احساس نکردم که این پیراهن فقط متعلق به من است، اما به مدت ۲۳ سال این افتخار و مسئولیت را داشتم که آن را بر تن کنم، از آن دفاع کنم و در ورزشگاه‌های سراسر جهان به همراه داشته باشم.»

او همچنین در این پیام گفت: «امروز زمان آن رسیده است که این پیراهن را به نسل آینده بسپارم. این تصمیم آسانی نبود، زیرا برخی تصمیم‌ها تنها با عقل گرفته نمی‌شوند، بلکه برخاسته از قلب است. سفری که در اوت ۲۰۰۳ آغاز شد و زندگی مرا برای همیشه تغییر داد، اکنون به پایان رسیده است.»

فدراسیون فوتبال پرتغال اعلام کرده است که «اجازه نمی‌دهد خداحافظی رونالدو از تیم ملی بدون ادای احترام شایسته به او برگزار شود.»

در بیانیه این فدراسیون آمده است: «خواسته قاطع و جدی ما این است که در برگزاری، برنامه‌ریزی و مشارکت فعال در مراسمی که همواره باید ادای احترامی شایسته به دوران پرافتخار فوتبال کریستیانو رونالدو باشد، نقش داشته باشیم؛ مراسمی که در آن هواداران و مردم پرتغال بتوانند بار دیگر از بازیکنی که خدمات بسیاری به کشورمان کرده است، قدردانی کنند و به افتخارات او ادای احترام کنند.»

لیونل مسی، اسطوره فوتبال آرژانتین و رقیب بزرگ رونالدو، هم در ماه اکتبر از بازی‌های ملی خداحافظی کرد.

قرار است فردا فهرست بازیکنان دعوت‌شده به تیم ملی پرتغال برای دیدارهای ماه نوامبر لیگ ملت‌های اروپا اعلام شود. پرتغال در این رقابت‌ها در خانه، میزبان دانمارک خواهد بود و در دیداری خارج از خانه، به مصاف ولز می‌رود.
